Tasks and Benchmarks. We evaluate MaAS on six public benchmarks covering three domains: (1) math reasoning, GSM8K<ref type="bibr" target="#b9">(Cobbe et al., 2021)</ref>, MATH<ref type="bibr" target="#b20">(Hendrycks et al., 2021)</ref>, and MultiArith<ref type="bibr" target="#b46">(Roy & Roth, 2016)</ref>; (2) code generation, HumanEval<ref type="bibr" target="#b7">(Chen et al., 2021)</ref> and MBPP<ref type="bibr" target="#b1">(Austin et al., 2021)</ref>); and (3) tool use, GAIA<ref type="bibr" target="#b36">(Mialon et al., 2023)</ref>. For the MATH benchmark, we follow<ref type="bibr" target="#b22">(Hong et al., 2024)</ref> in selecting 617 problems from four typical problem types (Combinatorics & Probability, Number Theory, Pre-algebra, Pre-calculus). The dataset statistics are in Appendix C.1.
